label: Grants
title: grant thinking
lead: Wins across Finnish and European grant programs. Thanks to analytical sequencing, fast reading, and the habit of understanding a product before writing about it.
paragraphs: I move through briefs quickly, map the logic, and write with the same block-scheme clarity I bring to products. That is the advantage: see the system, then argue it cleanly.
If you are preparing a grant — or stuck mid-way — a brainstorm session is often the shortest path to an honest next step.
